sourceName: NHANES 2017-2018 public-use Linked Mortality File pilot
policyPurpose: Define the minimum disclosure-safe output envelope for future NHANES public-use LMF weighted-domain tables before any public weighted rates, intervals or domain summaries can enter the Human Infra Web layer.

currentDecision.reason: The policy and synthetic validator are ready, but no real public NHANES weighted-domain output has been implemented or reviewed. The policy is an output-shape gate only.

rules.smallCellRule: For public export, every synthetic test cell with count below 5 must be suppressed. Real output must pass a separate disclosure review before any count-like or rate-like value is published.
rules.dfReviewRule: Any future public output cell with domain degrees of freedom below 8 must be suppressed or sent to manual statistical review before publication.
rules.rowLevelRule: Row-level records, SEQN, design fields, join keys, mortality linkage fields and record-level extracts cannot appear in the public output envelope.
rules.identifierRule: The envelope must declare that it contains no identifiers and must not contain identifier-like keys.
rules.unweightedCountRule: The public envelope cannot expose unweighted record counts or death counts from the public LMF pilot unless a future disclosure review explicitly allows them.
rules.publicAiUploadRule: NHANES-derived output envelopes cannot be uploaded to public AI systems unless they contain only synthetic validation data.

validatorContract.currentBoundary: synthetic validator only; no real NHANES weighted rates, intervals, unweighted counts, weighted sums, row-level records or mortality cells are present in this policy

prohibitedActions: Do not export row-level NHANES records or identifier-like fields.
Do not publish real weighted domain rates, intervals or count-like values from this policy alone.
Do not treat synthetic envelope validation as a disclosure review of real NHANES output.
Do not use disclosure validation as evidence of calibration, predictive validity, causal effect or individual usefulness.
Do not output individual death dates, personal medical advice or personal longevity rankings.
nextWork: Run the synthetic envelope validator and publish only the generated validator report.
After weighted-domain output implementation exists, bind every real output envelope to this policy and run a separate disclosure review.
Keep output envelope validation separate from effective sample size review, confidence interval review, calibration and external validation.
